principle: A target domain is cutover-scripted only when its backfill SQL, verification checks, and runner case exist together. Deferred domains remain explicit instead of being silently skipped.

media.reason: Legacy media state spans object-storage/upload surfaces and is not safely represented by the relational SQL-only backfill runner.

search.reason: Search is a rebuildable projection and does not use the relational domain cutover runner.

audit.reason: Audit sink extraction requires an immutable append-only retention and replay plan before traffic cutover.
